description: Terms and concepts used by the icanhazdadjoke API

terms.definition: A dad joke — a short, typically pun-based or groan-inducing humorous statement
terms.context: Core resource of the API; each joke has a unique ID and text content

terms.definition: A unique alphanumeric string identifying a specific joke in the database

The page number of the currently returned result set
The page number for the next page of results
The page number for the previous page of results
Total number of jokes matching the search criteria
Total number of pages for the result set given the current limit
Array of joke objects in a search result response
The search keyword echoed back in the search response
A permanent URL linking directly to a specific joke page on icanhazdadjoke.com
HTTP request header used to specify desired response format: application/json, text/plain, or text/html
HTTP request header identifying the calling library or application; recommended to include a contact URL

Slack message attachment array containing formatted joke content
A type of humor characterized by corny, pun-based, or anti-climactic punchlines, often told by fathers
